verdict.rationale: The Division offers opt-in, event-triggered alerts: text, push and email notices when registry records change or new filings are added to the public record, plus reminder messages for annual report and tax return deadlines. These are fixed subscription notifications, not user-defined rules that trigger arbitrary actions. Missing for 10: user-configurable rule definitions, actions beyond notifications (e.g. webhooks, automated filings or renewals), API or integration hooks for event-driven workflows, and independent corroboration.
